compute.basis: Appendix A.3 states RL uses 8x H20 for ~16 hours per run plus 4x H20 SFT; an 8B policy plus 8B verifier RL pipeline cannot run on a 16GB CPU-only laptop.

blockers: No code or training configs released (paper has no code links).
Requires 8x H20 GPUs for RL (~16h) and 4x H20 for SFT; not feasible on 8 CPU cores/16GB RAM.
SFT data is distilled from closed Gemini-2.5-Flash; verifier distills Qwen3-32B-Instruct rollouts.
Full training splits, prompts, and verifier data are not released.
title: Think-with-Rubrics: From External Evaluator to Internal Reasoning Guidance
